body: Witness->incident identity via perception Threat.cause (Attack(id) for gunshot/fight, Body(entity) for corpse) carried in CivilianState::Report and PoliceCall; incidents keyed by attack ids and victim. Rejected: resolving a call by offender entity (reports older unwitnessed crimes of the same offender, breaks 'no witness = 0 heat') and wanted-owned geometric witness sets (duplicates perception radii/LOS).

One heat contribution per incident: a call or cop sighting that resolves only to already-reported incidents is a no-op (no heat, no LastKnownPosition move, no timer reset). Shots of one offender within shooting_merge_seconds form one Shooting incident. Rejected: per-shot incidents (N callers of one SMG burst = N x 10 heat).

Search clock runs whenever heat > 0 (row = max(stars,1)); hidden counts only while unseen AND outside the circle and resets otherwise (GTA IV reading); sub-threshold heat clears by the same rule. Rejected: heat below 40 lingering until death.

Cop witness/sight before T11 = any live entity with Faction::Police + Position + Rotation (bare fixture in tests); no new Police marker. Rejected: a wanted-owned marker component T11 would have to remember to add.

Clearing Messages<PoliceCall> on OnExit(Wasted) considered and dropped: the incident log is cleared on OnEnter(Wasted), so a leaked call resolves to nothing; the extra clear would be ungateable dead weight.

Star HUD follows GDD 6.4 literally: earned and unseen stars blink (grey/off) whether inside or outside the circle; rejected PLAN/V2 steady-grey-inside (GTA IV reading) because GDD says 'когда ни один коп не видит игрока ... звёзды мигают'.
Same-attack Wound+Kill on one victim (shotgun pellets) collapses to Kill only; rejected recording both (80 heat for one trigger pull) — 10 pellets per blast make it real.

Wasted leak gate forces the stale call to complete in Playing via a named Report mutation; rejected waiting for a natural call, because a call finishing inside Wasted is dropped by message rotation/OnExit clear and the crimes.clear flip would stay GREEN.

Shared wanted-gate fixtures live in crates/gta_sim/tests/wanted_support/mod.rs (mod-included by wanted.rs and wanted_search.rs) instead of duplicating graph_app/Probe/spawn_cop/setup_w in both files; rejected moving them into tests/common (surgical: other suites do not need them).

Bare cop fixture (Faction::Police + Position + Rotation, no Transform) as planned: avian3d 0.7 registers Position -> Transform as a required component and transform_to_position overwrote Position with the default Transform (cop at the origin, every cop case passed vacuously). Fixture now carries a matching Transform.

t10.py mutating the planned victim before teleporting: the population recycled it (calm, >50 m, behind view) between the query and the BRP call, and bevy_remote 0.19.1 world.mutate_components on a despawned entity panics the game (builtin_methods.rs:1194). Scenario now teleports next to the victim first and re-checks both entities before mutating.

Cop witness check evaluated once per record_crimes tick against the player's eyes (all recorded crimes have the player as offender), then every touched incident is reported; equivalent to the per-incident check in the plan with fewer rays.
incident_memory_seconds validated at load against perception slots*tick + call_seconds in compose_sim; rejected retaining incidents referenced by in-flight calls (needs new civilian->wanted coupling)

Independent QA gates (two callers one corpse, cop+call same kill, cop-witnessed punch, 2-star search row, 5 kills -> 2 stars) kept as scratch/qa/qa_wanted_probe.rs and removed from the tree; rejected leaving them in crates/gta_sim/tests (QA does not change the product, the fixer/orchestrator decides whether to adopt the 2-star row gate).
Runtime natural-kill probe with t6.aim_at default tries=6 aborted (aim ray 0.153 m off the victim chest); rerun with tries=12 and per-kill skip instead of abort.
